About Funding Rates 
Funding rates help converge the price of the perpetual contract and the price of the underlying asset on the spot market. Funding rates are transferred directly between traders. Binance only facilitates the exchange of funding amounts between long-position and short-position holders. 
If the funding rate is positive, long-position holders will pay funding amounts to short-position holders, and vice versa. Funding amounts are calculated based on the nominal value of positions and funding rates.
Funding rates may vary depending on market conditions. The rates are generally much lower during times of low volatility, and may hit the maximum levels only during high volatility.
In extreme market conditions, funding rates may exceed the Maintenance Margin Ratio. As funding rates are deducted directly from users’ collateral, users are strongly advised to monitor their positions and available collateral closely to avoid margin calls and liquidations.

The funding rate settlement frequency of ZKPUSDT USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract will not be adjusted from every one hour to every four hours if the funding rate is more than the absolute value of 0.025% in any cycles between 2026-01-01 21:00 (UTC) to 2026-01-02 12:00 (UTC) . 

Notes
The adjustment will be completed within approximately 15 minutes after the aforementioned conditions are fulfilled. For example, when the funding rate settlement frequency should be updated from every one hour to every four hours at 08:00 (UTC) funding rate settlement, users will see the adjustment on the funding rate settlement frequency latest by 08:15 (UTC). 

A separate announcement will be made if Binance Futures decides to adjust the parameters of the aforementioned conditions. 

Please note that funding payments with a settlement frequency of every four hours occur at 00:00 (UTC), 04:00 (UTC), 08:00 (UTC), 12:00 (UTC), 16:00 (UTC), and 20:00 (UTC).

Users may visit the Real-Time Funding Rate and Funding Rate History pages to view the latest funding interval and historical funding rates. API users may query USDⓈ-M Futures funding rate information via the newly added endpoint: GET /fapi/v1/fundingInfo.
